snippet.text: /-- Literal R²-weighted angular residual. -/ noncomputable def thetaDensity (h C : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) (n : ℕ) (w : InnerPoint) : ℝ := w.1 ^ 3 / C * angularCoefficient h f n (radiusPoint w) — the integrand R²𝔯_{θ,n} of the first display, the swirl residual 𝔯_{θ,n} = (R/C)·angularCoefficient carrying Lean's swirl normalization C
